episode.title: Anthropic S-1 Shocker, Greatest Business Ever? Google’s $500B Wipeout, Midterm Predictions

chapters.title: Anthropic S-1 Breakdown: Greatest Business Ever?
AI's Biggest Problem and Anthropic's Doomer Showdown
Google Sheds $500B Market Cap in Worst Day Ever: What Went Wrong?

key_takes.speaker: David Sacks
key_takes.summary: Anthropic's IPO is probably the biggest venture outcome ever and the fastest value creation of any venture-backed company, and it will create huge wealth for employees.
key_takes.quote: I think this is probably going to be the biggest venture outcome of all time.

key_takes.speaker: David Sacks
key_takes.summary: The S-1 shows the widely reported $80B loss is a non-cash accounting effect of convertible notes, and Anthropic has been very capital-efficient with rising gross margins.
key_takes.quote: it turns out that that $80 billion loss is a phantom number

key_takes.speaker: David Friedberg
key_takes.summary: Every layer of the AI value stack is highly profitable, which points to real productivity gains, and Anthropic has reached only about 1% of its potential large customers.
key_takes.quote: a dollar that Nvidia spends turns into $18

key_takes.speaker: Chamath Palihapitiya
key_takes.summary: An analysis of the S-1 risk factors shows compute (data centers, financing commitments and power) is the binding constraint on Anthropic, not customer demand.
key_takes.quote: the single biggest risk to the Ant business is compute.

key_takes.speaker: Chamath Palihapitiya
key_takes.summary: Power and data centers are the political lever for 2028: Democrats gain if they slow the buildout and cause a slowdown, while Republicans must get power and data centers right.
key_takes.quote: slow down power and slow down data centers

key_takes.speaker: Chamath Palihapitiya
key_takes.summary: The AI complex's debt raising through 2027 equals about 30% of planned Treasury issuance, so it competes with governments for capital and creates a new systemic market risk.
key_takes.quote: It's like you have seven companies that are crowding out the treasury market.

key_takes.speaker: Jason Calacanis
key_takes.summary: Enterprise adoption is so early that token usage will grow about 500x, so the industry is underbuilding compute rather than overbuilding it.

key_takes.speaker: David Friedberg
key_takes.summary: Because AI organizations compete with governments for capital and power, governments will move to regulate and allocate compute capacity.
key_takes.quote: you're going to end up seeing compute get regulated in the future

key_takes.speaker: David Sacks
key_takes.summary: Anthropic is racing harder than anyone toward recursive self-improvement, which could cause a split between Anthropic and the AI doomer movement.
key_takes.quote: I do think that it's possible that an Anthropic doomer split is coming

key_takes.speaker: David Sacks
key_takes.summary: Anthropic is building an AGI monopoly while seeking regulatory capture; the IPO should expose it as big tech and weaken the case for regulatory moats.
key_takes.quote: they're going for regulatory capture and we should definitely not allow that to happen

key_takes.speaker: David Friedberg
key_takes.summary: Google Cloud is very strong, but core search is challenged, may be over-earning from ad pricing changes and needs a consumer AI replacement.
key_takes.quote: I think the core services, the core Google ad revenue is a real challenge

key_takes.speaker: Chamath Palihapitiya
key_takes.summary: Google IR must refute the viral claims that it abandoned second-price ad auctions, and its most important task is keeping Demis Hassabis.
key_takes.quote: How do you keep Demis at Google?

key_takes.speaker: David Sacks
key_takes.summary: Search revenue still grew 12% and only fell below 50% of revenue because Cloud doubled, so Google looks oversold after earnings.
key_takes.quote: I tend to think Google's a little bit oversold on this news today.

key_takes.speaker: David Sacks
key_takes.summary: Midterm polls are biased or even fraudulent and favor Democrats, so Republicans should ignore them and vote; the economy is not a disaster.
key_takes.quote: So, some of the polls are outright fraudulent

key_takes.speaker: Jason Calacanis
key_takes.summary: Democrats will sweep the House and Senate on low Trump approval and a fractured Republican base, followed by impeachment and two chaotic years.
key_takes.quote: I think Democrats are going to win the Senate.

predictions.speaker: Jason Calacanis
predictions.claim: Polymarket gives a 78% chance that Anthropic raises at least $95 billion in its IPO.
predictions.resolution_criteria: Anthropic IPO gross proceeds are at least $95B.
predictions.quote: 78% chance Anthropic raises at least 95 billion

predictions.speaker: Jason Calacanis
predictions.claim: Anthropic's IPO market cap will come in slightly under $2 trillion.
predictions.resolution_criteria: Anthropic's market cap at IPO pricing is just below $2T.
predictions.quote: assume it's going to be slightly under 2 trillion

predictions.speaker: Jason Calacanis
predictions.claim: Anthropic projects $100 billion of ARR by the end of 2026.

timeframe.text: by the end of the year

predictions.resolution_criteria: Anthropic reports an annualized revenue run rate of at least $100B by year-end 2026.
predictions.quote: they're projecting 100 billion of ARR by the end of the year.

predictions.speaker: David Sacks
predictions.claim: Anthropic's IPO will be the biggest venture outcome of all time, an exit on par with SpaceX's IPO.
predictions.resolution_criteria: Anthropic's IPO valuation equals or exceeds that of any previous venture-backed company exit, including SpaceX.
predictions.quote: I think this is probably going to be the biggest venture outcome of all time.

predictions.speaker: David Sacks
predictions.claim: If recursive self-improvement has kicked in, Anthropic's lead over competitors could grow.
predictions.resolution_criteria: Anthropic's lead in benchmarks and enterprise share over rival labs widens.
predictions.quote: then their lead could actually grow.

predictions.speaker: David Friedberg
predictions.claim: Anthropic, and labs generally, will segment pricing: cheaper tokens for easy tasks and premium prices for high-intelligence tasks.
predictions.resolution_criteria: Anthropic introduces clearly tiered token pricing by task difficulty or intelligence level.
predictions.quote: And I'm I envision that's where everyone's going to go.

predictions.speaker: Chamath Palihapitiya
predictions.claim: Market whispers say Anthropic's Q3 2026 revenue growth moderated to about 50%, which will show in an updated filing if the IPO comes after November 11.

timeframe.text: Q3 disclosure ahead of the IPO

predictions.resolution_criteria: Anthropic's disclosed Q3 2026 revenue growth is around 50% quarter over quarter.
predictions.quote: the revenue growth kind of moderated to sort of like the 50% range

predictions.speaker: Chamath Palihapitiya
predictions.claim: Democrats will try to slow power and data-center buildout to slow the economy before the 2028 election.
predictions.resolution_criteria: Democratic officials or legislation move to restrict data-center permitting or power hookups before November 2028.
predictions.quote: slow down power and slow down data centers

predictions.speaker: David Sacks
predictions.claim: Democrats will try to sabotage the superintelligence buildout because it is driving the Trump economy.
predictions.resolution_criteria: Democratic leadership advances measures that restrict AI development or data centers.
predictions.quote: Democrats want to do anything they can to sabotage the Trump economy

predictions.speaker: Chamath Palihapitiya
predictions.claim: Anthropic can become a revenue business in the hundreds of billions of dollars within 3 to 7 years.
predictions.resolution_criteria: Anthropic's annual revenue reaches $200B or more by 2033.
predictions.quote: a very large revenue business in the hundreds of billions of dollars

predictions.speaker: Chamath Palihapitiya
predictions.claim: Anthropic needs to raise $80B to $120B, and the IPO will price at a $1.3T to $1.7T valuation, about $1.5T at the midpoint.
predictions.resolution_criteria: Anthropic's IPO pricing valuation falls between $1.3T and $1.7T.
predictions.stated_confidence: If I had to just kind of guess
predictions.quote: I kind of think it'll come in around 1.5.

predictions.speaker: David Sacks
predictions.claim: Counting about $100B of IPO proceeds and an $80B debt facility, Anthropic will soon have over $300B of dry powder, enough to back its compute commitments.
predictions.resolution_criteria: Anthropic's post-IPO cash plus available credit exceeds $300B.
predictions.quote: this is a company with over 300 billion of dry powder

predictions.speaker: Chamath Palihapitiya
predictions.claim: Because Anthropic needs to raise less than expected, it will have more pricing power and manage its float better, giving a constructive setup into the IPO.
predictions.resolution_criteria: Anthropic's IPO prices at or above its range and trades well initially.
predictions.quote: give you a constructive read going into the IPO.

predictions.speaker: Chamath Palihapitiya
predictions.claim: AI companies' borrowing through 2027, about 30% of planned Treasury issuance, will compete with Treasuries for demand, raising borrowing costs either for the AI complex or for the US government.
predictions.resolution_criteria: Higher Treasury auction yields or tails, or wider credit spreads on hyperscaler and AI debt, through 2027.
predictions.stated_confidence: whether we like it or not
predictions.quote: they are going to start competing for demand.

predictions.speaker: Jason Calacanis
predictions.claim: As enterprises deploy agents to 100-200 million white-collar workers, token usage will grow about 500x and compute will be undersupplied.
predictions.resolution_criteria: Industry token consumption grows by orders of magnitude, with persistent compute shortages.
predictions.quote: The token usage is going 500x.

predictions.speaker: Chamath Palihapitiya
predictions.claim: Regulatory approvals, utility staffing and equipment shortages will keep the US from building compute as fast as demand requires.
predictions.resolution_criteria: Data-center and power-interconnection backlogs persist and buildout lags demand.
predictions.quote: We can't do it even if we wanted to do it.

predictions.speaker: David Friedberg
predictions.claim: Governments will pass laws to regulate compute, assigning who gets access to how much compute capacity.
predictions.resolution_criteria: A government enacts a law that allocates or licenses access to compute capacity.
predictions.quote: you're going to end up seeing compute get regulated in the future

predictions.speaker: David Friedberg
predictions.claim: Government versus private-market control of AI will be the major political battle over the next five years.
predictions.resolution_criteria: Control of AI (government vs private) becomes a central partisan policy fight through 2031.
predictions.quote: that'll be the huge battle that's going to brew over the next half decade

predictions.speaker: David Sacks
predictions.claim: With a roughly $2T market cap, Anthropic will gain even more influence in Washington, and going public will cause it to be seen as a big tech monopoly.
predictions.resolution_criteria: Anthropic's lobbying and political spending grow, and it is treated as big tech in policy debates.
predictions.quote: they're going to have even more influence in Washington

predictions.speaker: David Sacks
predictions.claim: Anthropic's pursuit of recursive self-improvement may cause a split with the AI doomer movement.
predictions.resolution_criteria: Prominent AI safety or doomer organizations publicly break with or campaign against Anthropic.
predictions.quote: I do think that it's possible that an Anthropic doomer split is coming

predictions.speaker: Chamath Palihapitiya
predictions.claim: Because the AI complex competes with Treasuries for capital, risks to AI stocks lean more to the downside than the upside, with possible systemic risk-off.
predictions.resolution_criteria: A broad selloff in AI stocks tied to funding costs or rate pressure.
predictions.quote: many roads lead to downside risk more than upside risk.

predictions.speaker: Jason Calacanis
predictions.claim: Anthropic's business could become bigger than the iPhone, Google search and Amazon retail franchises combined, with revenue heading to $300B and eventually $600B.
predictions.resolution_criteria: Anthropic's cumulative revenue over its first seven revenue years exceeds the combined totals for those three franchises.
predictions.quote: It's possible Anthropic's business is bigger than the top three franchises

predictions.speaker: David Sacks
predictions.claim: Talk on X is that after Anthropic cut token prices, demand reaccelerated and the company returned to its previous growth rate after Q3 hiccups.
predictions.resolution_criteria: Anthropic's Q4 2026 revenue growth reaccelerates compared with Q3.
predictions.stated_confidence: who knows if we can totally believe this
predictions.quote: it seems like they're back to resuming their previous growth

predictions.speaker: David Sacks
predictions.claim: Because of Jevons paradox and token-heavy uses like agents and cyber defense, token prices will keep falling while the total AI market keeps growing.
predictions.resolution_criteria: Per-token prices fall while total AI model revenue rises year over year.
predictions.quote: So, the price will keep going down, but the market size keeps increasing.

predictions.speaker: Jason Calacanis
predictions.claim: Once cyber risk is mitigated, daily AI use at work will rise from about 10% of workers to 60-80%.
predictions.resolution_criteria: Gallup's survey shows 60%+ of US workers using AI daily at work.
predictions.quote: go from 10% of people being daily users to 60, 70, 80%.

predictions.speaker: Jason Calacanis
predictions.claim: Following Uber's move, large companies will start buying AI subscriptions for every employee.
predictions.resolution_criteria: Multiple large enterprises announce company-wide AI assistant deployments for all employees.
predictions.quote: That's going to be the next shoe to drop

predictions.speaker: Unknown
predictions.claim: A movement to break up Anthropic, for example separating the lab and token business from subscriptions, could emerge.
predictions.resolution_criteria: Regulators or politicians publicly propose breaking up Anthropic.
predictions.quote: It could happen.

predictions.speaker: Jason Calacanis
predictions.claim: OpenAI will file to go public and disclose its financials.
predictions.resolution_criteria: OpenAI publicly files an S-1 registration statement.
predictions.quote: when open AI files

predictions.speaker: David Friedberg
predictions.claim: Google Cloud has a credible path to strong, progressive growth over the next couple of years.
predictions.resolution_criteria: Google Cloud revenue and operating income keep growing strongly through 2028.
predictions.quote: the next couple of years of really progressive growth in that business.

predictions.speaker: David Friedberg
predictions.claim: Advertisers will notice Google over-earning from its ad pricing changes and cut spend, so core search will look weaker over time.
predictions.resolution_criteria: Google search revenue growth decelerates further or turns negative as advertisers cut spend.
predictions.quote: advertisers will see that, they'll experience that, they'll reduce spend

predictions.speaker: Chamath Palihapitiya
predictions.claim: If the claims that Google is pulling future ad revenue into the present gain momentum, the market will react badly, and Alphabet will go through a shareholder-base transition as a more diversified conglomerate.
predictions.resolution_criteria: Alphabet stock underperforms on continued ad-auction concerns, and search falls further as a share of revenue.
predictions.quote: the market will react badly to it.

predictions.speaker: David Sacks
predictions.claim: Alphabet stock is oversold after its Q3 earnings drop, which implies a rebound.
predictions.resolution_criteria: GOOGL trades above its post-earnings close of October 29-30, 2026 in the following months.
predictions.quote: I tend to think Google's a little bit oversold on this news today.

predictions.speaker: Jason Calacanis
predictions.claim: Alphabet's dependence on search will keep falling below 50% of revenue as other businesses grow, and Jason is long the stock after buying during the show.
predictions.resolution_criteria: Search revenue keeps falling as a share of Alphabet revenue, and GOOGL rises from its post-earnings level.
predictions.quote: I just bought more shares on Google while doing the show.

predictions.speaker: Chamath Palihapitiya
predictions.claim: In the 2026 midterms, Republicans will keep the Senate and Democrats will win a narrow House majority, a modest Democratic 'spritz'.
predictions.resolution_criteria: 2026 midterm results: Republicans control the Senate and Democrats win a narrow House majority.
predictions.stated_confidence: I think it's still set up
predictions.quote: Republicans keep the Senate and the Democrats to have a narrow majority

predictions.speaker: Chamath Palihapitiya
predictions.claim: If Democrats win the House, they will subpoena widely and release documents to create FUD before 2028, and an economic slowdown would help them.
predictions.resolution_criteria: A Democratic House majority issues many investigative subpoenas and document releases in 2027-2028.
predictions.quote: start subpoenaing everybody and start to do disclosure, discovery

predictions.speaker: David Sacks
predictions.claim: The 2026 midterms will be a normal out-party midterm gain rather than the Democratic tsunami the media is predicting.
predictions.resolution_criteria: Democratic seat gains in the 2026 midterms are within the historical norm, not a wave or bloodbath.
predictions.quote: I think it might be a more normal midterm result.
predictions.resolution_note: Polymarket 'Will the Democratic Party control the House after the 2026 Midterm elections?' resolved Yes

predictions.speaker: Jason Calacanis
predictions.claim: Democrats will win control of the Senate in the 2026 midterms, in line with Polymarket's 68%.
predictions.resolution_criteria: Democrats hold a Senate majority after the 2026 midterm results.
predictions.stated_confidence: I believe that ... very easy sweep
predictions.quote: I think Democrats are going to win the Senate.

predictions.speaker: Jason Calacanis
predictions.claim: Democrats will win control of the House in the 2026 midterms, in line with Polymarket's 92%.
predictions.resolution_criteria: Democrats win a House majority in the 2026 midterms.
predictions.quote: And house, obviously everybody believes that.

predictions.speaker: Jason Calacanis
predictions.claim: After Democrats take Congress, Trump will be impeached again.
predictions.resolution_criteria: The House passes articles of impeachment against Trump during the 2027-2028 Congress.
predictions.quote: I think we're going to go right back to Trump being impeached.

predictions.speaker: Jason Calacanis
predictions.claim: After two chaotic years, Republicans will move past the Trump era, including J.D. Vance and Marco Rubio, and pick a new, more populist 2028 champion not yet identifiable.
predictions.resolution_criteria: Neither J.D. Vance nor Marco Rubio is the 2028 Republican presidential nominee.
predictions.stated_confidence: That's not my personal belief, that's just my analysis
predictions.quote: I think that means they put J.D. Vance and Marco Rubio to bed

predictions.speaker: David Sacks
predictions.claim: If Democrats take Congress, their extremism will become visible and the political pendulum will swing back.
predictions.resolution_criteria: Public opinion shifts against a Democratic Congress, e.g. falling congressional approval before 2028.
predictions.quote: you're likely to see how nutty they are

stock_implications.claim: Anthropic is probably the biggest venture outcome ever, with improving margins and capital efficiency.
stock_implications.timeframe: into and after the November 2026 IPO
stock_implications.rationale: The S-1 shows strong growth, gross margins near 85% and large cash reserves, which supports a strong IPO.
stock_implications.speaker: David Sacks
stock_implications.note: Private before the IPO; the planned ticker ANT was not yet trading.

stock_implications.claim: Every layer of the AI value stack is highly profitable, starting with Nvidia's roughly 75% chip margins.
stock_implications.rationale: Profitability and fast-growing demand at every downstream layer support continued chip spending.
stock_implications.speaker: David Friedberg

stock_implications.claim: Token usage will grow about 500x and compute will be undersupplied.
stock_implications.rationale: Demand far above compute supply implies continued strong spending on chips and infrastructure.
stock_implications.speaker: Jason Calacanis

stock_implications.claim: AI-complex borrowing equal to about 30% of Treasury issuance will compete with Treasuries and push up borrowing costs.
stock_implications.rationale: More competition for duration demand could push Treasury yields up and long-bond prices down.
stock_implications.speaker: Chamath Palihapitiya

stock_implications.claim: Microsoft nearly doubled revenue with flat headcount and Satya halved its debt while peers levered up.
stock_implications.rationale: AI-driven productivity gains and a stronger balance sheet than other hyperscalers.
stock_implications.speaker: Chamath Palihapitiya

stock_implications.claim: Google looks oversold because search still grew 12% and Cloud doubled.
stock_implications.rationale: The post-earnings selloff overstates search deterioration while other segments grow fast.
stock_implications.speaker: David Sacks

stock_implications.claim: Jason bought more Alphabet shares during the show because the company is diversifying beyond search.
stock_implications.rationale: Searches are still growing, other businesses are scaling, and Alphabet holds stakes in Anthropic, SpaceX and Waymo.
stock_implications.speaker: Jason Calacanis

stock_implications.claim: Google's core search ad business is challenged and may be over-earning, while Google Cloud is tremendous.
stock_implications.rationale: A strong cloud business is offset by risk to search revenue from AI and ad-pricing changes.
stock_implications.speaker: David Friedberg

stock_implications.claim: Amazon owns a big stake in Anthropic and will be a big winner from the IPO.
stock_implications.rationale: A large Anthropic stake gets marked to a public valuation.
stock_implications.speaker: Jason Calacanis

macro_themes.stance_summary: The hosts see Anthropic's planned $100B IPO at about $1.5-2T as historic and constructive; it would be the largest IPO ever.
Compute and data centers are the binding constraint; demand (token usage, enterprise adoption) is seen as far ahead of buildout.
Power and data-center permitting is the key political lever for 2028, and regulatory and utility bottlenecks slow the buildout.
Chamath argues AI shows up as productivity gains (Microsoft revenue up sharply with flat headcount) rather than job loss.
Chamath warns that AI-complex debt raising is crowding out Treasury demand, a new systemic risk that could raise borrowing costs.
Sacks warns about the Democratic SI agenda and Anthropic's push for regulatory capture; Friedberg expects governments to regulate compute.
Sacks argues Anthropic leads the race to recursive self-improvement, which may split it from the doomers.
The panel debates whether AI threatens Google search; Friedberg and Chamath see real risk, while Sacks and Jason think the selloff is overdone.
Jason expects a Democratic sweep and impeachment, Chamath expects Democrats to take only the House, and Sacks distrusts polls and expects a normal midterm.
